# Using AI Tools in Email Marketing

Improve your email marketing by using artificial intelligence to your advantage. Learn about leveraging AI in email marketing here.

![Using AI in Email Marketing hero](https://mailchimp.com/ctf/images/yzco4xsimv0y/2wHEINhMnweWk4n3O1aLsP/249415af25f6dc74ea284232fd867f85/aiemailmarketing_hero_photo.jpg?w=480&q=70)

To say that modern marketing is complex is such an understatement that it’s hard to describe the fault in those words.

You have to understand psychology, sociology, advanced mathematics, and so much more to get ahead of the best marketers.

Fortunately, you can do all of that without earning multiple advanced degrees. All you have to do is leverage technology, which can transform everything.

This can be easily done with email marketing. Using artificial intelligence (AI), email marketers can dramatically improve their efficiency and efficacy. Let’s explore how.

![AI email marketing illustration concept ](https://mailchimp.com/ctf/images/yzco4xsimv0y/2gzrgQBzhU42fKGYttJ5B1/68f38515bc757891c9617dacf4e6381d/aiemailmarketing_module1_illustration.png?w=580&q=70)

What is Al email marketing?

The process of using machine learning to enhance email marketing strategies and campaigns.

## How to use AI email marketing tools

How do you use AI in email marketing? That’s a big question, and because there's so much AI technology out there, the answer can be complex. AI can crunch numbers, write email subject lines, inform your [email marketing strategy](https://mailchimp.com/resources/create-an-email-marketing-strategy/), and much more.

There’s a lot to cover, but we can hit the most common uses below. So, let's look at AI email marketing tools and what they can do

### Content ideation

Sometimes, the most challenging part of email marketing is coming up with general ideas. Once you know what to talk about, making content becomes easier. If you've ever stared at a blank screen or page trying to start a project, you already understand this.

[AI writing tools](https://mailchimp.com/resources/ai-writing-tools/) can completely solve this problem easily. ChatGPT has made a lot of waves, and it’s pretty well known, so let’s use it as an example (this particular AI technology will come up again).

As a natural language generation tool, you can type prompts into ChatGPT, and it will give you full-fledged ideas. You can tell it about your business, and it will customize different ideas for your brand.

Even if you don’t end up using any of the AI ideas verbatim, it’s a tool that can always get your creativity flowing. This is only the first example of email marketing with AI.

### Email validation

One of the significant challenges of email marketing is curating a quality email list. AI can help.

There are a few different ways for AI to implement itself into this process.

First, AI can review your existing email marketing program lists and compare metrics to determine the probability that a single email address (or an entire list) is valuable. By using this, you can skip low-quality emails and save a lot of time and effort.

Second, AI-based email marketing can help you track responses and interactions to rank the quality of various email addresses. With that information, AI tools can even curate an email list for you.

### Sending frequency

AI often shines when it gets the chance to do math (a powerful feature of machine learning), and this is one of those times. It might seem like you can send emails on a regular schedule and succeed, but marketing is far more complicated than that.

If you send emails too soon, you risk burning out recipients, leading to them not reading your messages. They might even unsubscribe or block your email address.

But, if you send them out too rarely, you miss opportunities.

AI can track the value generated by each email you send and analyze the frequency of your efforts to help you build an optimized schedule.

Table of Contents

Search “**best AI email marketing tools**” on Google, and you’ll get endless lists of options—each tool boasting a unique AI feature to improve open rates, automate tasks, or personalize content.

The real challenge isn’t finding an AI email marketing tool—it’s deciding which one to use.

With so many choices, each claiming to be the smartest, it’s hard to tell which tools actually deliver results and which just look good on paper.

This listicle of top AI email marketing tools doesn’t just introduce the best options—it helps you figure out which one truly fits your needs.

Let’s get started.

## How did we evaluate the top AI email marketing tools?

Most AI-based email marketing tools may look impressive on paper. But if you need a fair unbiased overview of how the tool performs, look at real-world feedback and customer stories for evidence.

To help you pick the best AI email marketing tool, we carefully analyzed customer reviews on Capterra, G2, and TrustPilot. We then evaluated the tools based on these key factors:

*   **AI capabilities:** Analyzed AI capabilities to help with content generation, personalization, and automation
*   **Ease of use:** Assessed the intuitiveness and simplicity of a tool for non-technical users and checked if complements your email marketing strategy
*   **Integration options:** Analyzed the tool’s integrations with CRMs, eCommerce platforms, and other marketing tools
*   **Analytics and reporting:** Assessed if the tool provides actionable insights and helps with performance tracking
*   **Pricing and scalability:** Is the pricing cost-effective for the businesses it caters to?

While choosing an AI-powered tool, evaluate where it ranks based on these factors. And make sure it complements and streamlines your email marketing workflow without creating disruptions.

## 7 Best AI Email Marketing Tools

Before we get into the detailed overview of each tool, here’s a quick table featuring key features, pricing, and suitability groups for each tool.

| Tool | Key feature | Pricing | Best for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Optimove](https://bizplanr.ai/blog/ai-email-marketing-tools#optimove) | Multi-channel marketing campaign | Customized | Large businesses |
| [Kit](https://bizplanr.ai/blog/ai-email-marketing-tools#kit) | E-commerce integration | $25 onwards | Creators |
| [Rasa](https://bizplanr.ai/blog/ai-email-marketing-tools#rasa) | Content Featuring | $190 onwards | Businesses that need newsletter automation |
| [GetResponse](https://bizplanr.ai/blog/ai-email-marketing-tools#getresponse) | For AI-powered email and campaign generation | $15 onwards | SMBs (small and mid-sized businesses) |
| [Mailmodo](https://bizplanr.ai/blog/ai-email-marketing-tools#mailmodo) | Interactive emails | $49 onwards | Marketers and eCommerce businesses |
| [Zeta](https://bizplanr.ai/blog/ai-email-marketing-tools#zeta) | Advanced audience segmentation | Custom | Data-driven marketers |

Let’s now explore these tools in detail.

### 1\. Optimove: For cross-channel marketing campaigns

[Optimove](https://www.optimove.com/) is a customer-led marketing platform that uses OptiMail, an AI-powered email marketing tool, to help businesses build hyper-personalized email campaigns.

The platform uses predictive analytics and automation to enhance customer engagement and retention. Its built-in Customer Data Platform (CDP) enables businesses to analyze customer behavior, create hyper-specific audience segments, and send AI-optimized emails that drive conversions.

OptiMail offers dynamic content updates, automated product recommendations, and AI-driven send-time optimization to ensure emails reach the right audience at the perfect moment.

Optimove is ideal for businesses that need help with cross-channel campaign management.

#### Key features

*   **Personalization tags and conditional content:** Uses database-linked tags and conditional logic to customize professional emails for each recipient
*   **Delivery validation and testing:** Verifies email deliverability and inbox placement before sending
*   **Multi-touch campaign automation:** Orchestrates automated email sequences across different customer touchpoints
*   **Intelligent customer segmentation:** AI algorithms create specific customer segments that help deliver hyper-targeted email campaigns
*   **Optimove integration:** OptiMail seamlessly integrates with Optimove and requires no additional integrations or services
*   **Performance analytics:** Offers deep insights into your email campaigns with robust analytics and reporting tools
*   **Multi-channel integration:** Seamlessly integrates with other marketing channels helping you run cohesive cross-channel marketing campaigns

#### Limitations

*   A clunky interface that’s difficult to navigate
*   Advanced AI-driven features and multi-brand management require time to master
*   Optimove excels at retention and personalization but may not be the best tool for lead generation
*   Requires businesses to have a well-structured customer data
*   Exporting data is not as seamless as some competitors

#### Pricing

Optimove offers customized quotes depending on the size and stage of your business

#### Who should use Optimove?

Optimove is suited for mid-to-large-scale businesses that leverage customer data to design and deliver highly converting marketing campaigns.

#### Ratings

**Capterra:** 4.3  
**G2:** 4.6

### 2\. Kit (formerly ConvertKit): For creators

[Kit](https://kit.com/) (formerly ConvertKit) is an email-first marketing platform designed for creators looking to grow their audience, engage fans, and drive sales. It provides a one-stop solution for building email lists, automating workflows, and selling digital products.

With Kit, users can set up targeted email sequences, run automated campaigns, and monetize content directly from the platform. Its AI-powered creator network helps expand reach through seamless cross-promotions.

The platform’s intuitive visual dashboard offers a
